title: Kalaignar and Nurse Cauvery: The River Water Wordplay — 2009
summary: Parched with thirst after major surgery, Karunanidhi was denied water by the ICU nurse. Learning her name was 'Cauvery', he joked: 'Cauvery? No wonder you won't give me water—in Karnataka or Chennai!'
keywords: Kalaignar and Nurse Cauvery: The River Water Wordplay — 2009
full_text:
In February 2009, eighty-four-year-old Chief Minister Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi underwent major spinal surgery at Sri Ramachandra Hospital in Chennai.

Following hours of delicate surgery, he was transferred to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). Strict post-operative medical protocols barred him from drinking liquids for several hours.

As the anesthesia wore off, Karunanidhi awoke with parched lips and overwhelming thirst.

Spotting the duty nurse at his bedside, Karunanidhi gestured weakly: "Please... give me a sip of water..."

The nurse smiled sympathetically but stood firm: "Sir, doctor's strict orders. You cannot have water for another two hours. Please bear with us."

Karunanidhi closed his eyes in discomfort. A few minutes later, he opened them again and asked softly: "Nurse, what is your name?"

The nurse replied respectfully: "My name is Cauvery, sir."

Despite severe surgical trauma, Karunanidhi's legendary wit fired instantly!

A faint smile touched his dry lips as he murmured:
"Ah... your name is Cauvery? I should have known! 
No wonder you refuse to give me water!
Whether it is in Karnataka or inside this Chennai hospital, Cauvery stubbornly refuses to release a single drop of water to us!"

Doctors, family members, and Nurse Cauvery herself were moved to tears, yet broke into helpless laughter at the bedside!

The nurse wiped a tear from her eye, marveling: "Sir, even in this intensive care unit, your political wit has not left you!"

Transforming physical pain into sparkling wordplay, Karunanidhi demonstrated that his love for Tamil culture and the vital water rights of his people was woven into the very fiber of his soul.
moral: Even in the throes of agonizing post-surgical pain and medical sedation, Karunanidhi's linguistic brilliance and lifelong devotion to Tamil Nadu's water rights shone through.
